title: A Four-Term Counterexample to the Special Image Conjecture in Three Pairs
summary: An explicit four-term polynomial disproves the Special Image Conjecture in three contraction pairs.

verification.scope: Written all-power identities and an accompanying finite exact regression checker.
verification.limits: The deposited frontier 2 <= r_SIC <= 3 is historical; later local work establishes failure with two pairs. The finite checker alone is not an all-order theorem proof.

deposited_title: An Four-Term Counterexample to the Special Image Conjecture in Three Pairs
abstract: An explicit four-term counterexample to the Special Image Conjecture in three contraction pairs, obtained by a one-pair bihomogeneous lift of Christopher D. Long's SU(2) Mathieu counterexample. For f=tau(t-y)(wz+vt) and g=y, the paper proves E(f^m)=0 and [t]E(g f^m)=(-1)^(m-1)(m+1)!m! for every m>=1. Thus the minimum possible failure dimension is two or three.
